# Living PRD

## RF-03 — Report export

The user exports the sales report in CSV, with filters by period and by salesperson. The export includes cancelled items, marked in the "status" column.

### Acceptance criteria

- The exported file opens in Excel without breaking accents.
- The period filter limits the exported rows.
- Cancelled items appear in the export, identified.

## Out of scope

- Excel export (xlsx).
